instruction: Locate Barbie dolls intended for children and present them starting with the least expensive.

metadata.explanation: Task variation searches for Barbie dolls instead of Spider-Man toys, maintaining the same pattern: search for a toy brand for kids and sort by price ascending. Uses existing evaluator functions to verify breadcrumbs and URL parameters on Kohl's website.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies all instruction requirements: searching for Barbie dolls (via breadcrumb and URL 'Barbie'/'barbie'), for kids (via breadcrumb and URL 'Kids'), and sorted by lowest price (via sort selector 'Price Low-High' and URL parameter 'S=4')

Getter function get_active_tab_html_parse with category 'class&url' properly extracts breadcrumb navigation elements from class 'pmpSearch_breadcrumb', sort selector from class 'sbSelector', and URL parameters

Data flow is correct: getter returns {key: boolean} format with lowercase keys, expected values use matching lowercase keys ('barbie', 'toys', 'kids', 'price low-high'), metric check_direct_json_object compares them correctly
Metric function check_direct_json_object properly handles rule-based expected values and performs exact boolean comparison for all required fields including the negative check 'is_other_exist': false
Evaluator has complete coverage of the multi-part instruction: product type (Barbie dolls), target audience (kids), and sort order (lowest price first)
